title: Re-point platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal acceptance[0] and [3] from `webhook` to `tool`: webhooks are held per namespace since #32577
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33089 · platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal · acceptance[0], acceptance[3]

Kind: checklist re-point (stale spec), no product change.

## Observed at 8e3d4a54
Two scratch packages in two namespaces, com.qa.addr-a (qa_a) and com.qa.addr-b (qa_b), each declaring webhook `qa_hook` (isActive false; `requires: ['webhooks','realtime']`):
- `os package install` of both → both exit 0, both listed by `GET /api/v1/packages`; registry logs "Registered webhook: com.qa.addr-a:qa_hook" and "…com.qa.addr-b:qa_hook". The package-less `GET /api/v1/meta/webhook/qa_hook` → 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT naming both holders. Re-checked with a third namespace.
- Cold boot of a `defineStack` with `packages[]` = the two bodies → boot completes (health 200), no "Bare-name conflict at boot" warning for the webhook.
Rev 3 expects the second install refused 422 naming both packages, and exactly one boot warning.

## Why the product is right
#32577 (e55347d2, 2026-11-13 05:13Z, "declared webhooks are held per namespace, each holder dispatched and switched as its own", ADR-0150 child B) added `webhook` to objectql's `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`. That landed about an hour after #32965 (cf1b55c0, 04:04Z) re-pointed this item from `flow` (narrowed by #31696) to `webhook` as a type still held once per deployment. Control: the same legs with a `tool` give the expected shape — second install 422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED ("…declares the tool \"qa_tool\", already held by package \"com.qa.addr-c\" — rename it to \"qa_d_qa_tool\"…"), and the cold boot logs exactly one "Bare-name conflict at boot" warning, for the tool.

## Proposed change
Re-point acceptance[0] and [3] (and acceptance[1]'s trailing "webhook, connector and tool are still one holder per deployment", the title and the fixtures) to `tool` (or `connector`) — the only declared types left with one holder per deployment. Add the fixture note that a webhook-declaring package needs `requires: ['webhooks','realtime']`. Since this item has now gone stale twice (flow, then webhook) as ADR-0150 child B narrows family by family, consider deriving the type from `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`'s complement in the item text rather than naming one. Bump the revision and add a history row.
